description: Upgrade Symfony 7.3 to 7.4 LTS and create OiMailflowBundle from NewsletterBundle

userStories.title: Update composer.json for Symfony 7.4
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to update the Symfony version constraint to 7.4 LTS.
userStories.notes: File aggiornato: tutte le dipendenze symfony/* ora usano 7.4.*. Il repository path per MailflowBundle è stato aggiunto. La verifica bin/console richiede PHP in esecuzione.

userStories.title: Run Symfony upgrade
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to execute composer update and resolve any conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: bin/console debug:container runs without critical deprecation warnings
userStories.notes: Richiede PHP in esecuzione. Da eseguire manualmente.

userStories.title: Verify existing Oimmei bundles load
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify all existing Oimmei bundles work with SF 7.4.
userStories.notes: Richiede composer update + PHP. Da eseguire dopo US-002.

userStories.title: Verify JWT authentication works
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to confirm JWT login still functions after upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/auth/login returns JWT token with valid credentials
GET /api/v1/user returns user data with valid JWT
userStories.notes: Richiede ambiente running. Da eseguire dopo US-003.

userStories.title: Create MailflowBundle directory structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the basic directory structure for OiMailflowBundle.
userStories.notes: Struttura completa creata: src/Entity/, src/DependencyInjection/, src/Enum/, src/Form/Type/, src/Repository/, config/.

userStories.title: Create MailflowBundle composer.json
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the composer.json for the new bundle.
userStories.notes: composer.json creato con tutte le dipendenze SF7.4: mailer, messenger, form, validator, doctrine orm ^3.0.

userStories.title: Create OiMailflowBundle main class
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the bundle main class.
userStories.notes: OiMailflowBundle.php creato con AbstractBundle (SF7 pattern moderno).

userStories.title: Create DependencyInjection classes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the bundle extension and configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses modern SF7 service configuration patterns
userStories.notes: OiMailflowExtension.php e Configuration.php creati con parametri: default_batch_size, default_send_interval, smtp_connection_timeout, max_retry_count.

userStories.title: Create services.yaml configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the bundle services configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses modern YAML format (no _defaults legacy patterns)
userStories.notes: config/services.yaml creato con autowire/autoconfigure, esclude Entity e DependencyInjection.

userStories.title: Add repository path to server-sf7 composer.json
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to configure composer to find the local bundle.
userStories.notes: Repository path aggiunto come primo elemento dell'array repositories. oi/mailflow: @dev aggiunto in require.

userStories.title: Install and register MailflowBundle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to install the bundle via composer and register it.
acceptanceCriteria: bin/console debug:container | grep mailflow shows bundle services
No deprecation warnings for the bundle
userStories.notes: Richiede PHP + composer in esecuzione. Da eseguire manualmente.

userStories.title: Create oi_mailflow.yaml configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the bundle configuration file.
userStories.notes: config/packages/oi_mailflow.yaml creato con tutti e quattro i parametri: default_batch_size=50, default_send_interval=30, smtp_connection_timeout=10, max_retry_count=3. Verifica bin/console da fare dopo installazione bundle (US-011).

userStories.title: Verify frontend login works
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the Next.js frontend still works after upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: JWT token is stored in frontend
User profile page loads user data
No CORS errors in browser console
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Frontend typecheck e test passano (npm run typecheck: OK, npm run test: OK). Verifica browser da fare dopo upgrade backend.
